news.title: Is crypto the logical next step for AI-to-AI and AI-to-Business payments?
news.summary:
I've been thinking about the current AI trend and how the infrastructure might evolve.

Phase 1 was clearly the GPU boom for training the models.

Phase 2 seems to be the inference and edge computing boom for actually running them everywhere.

Does it make sense that Phase 3 could be autonomous AI agents needing a native settlement layer?
